about: Nectary repayment queue, public append-only ledger. Sibling of ledger/units.json and ledger/credit.json with the same hash chain. Rules: docs/repayment-queue.md. Check: python3 tools/queue.py verify

queue.name: Nectary repayment queue
queue.counted_in: US dollars of cash, held in cents. Repayment of the ticket's price fixed before work, 1x, never more; no interest while a claim waits.
queue.order: one line per hoster, in the order claims were accepted; the oldest open claim is paid first, part by part
queue.funded_by: each closed month: half the hoster's profit (its books in ledger/credit.json) less what serving builder credit cost it that month
queue.words: Never a stake, share, investment or return (L-1).
